solutions.title: Quadratic DP
solutions.strategy: Sort by end time and scan all earlier compatible jobs for each current job.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each job can compare against every earlier job.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Sorted jobs and one DP array are stored.

solutions.title: Binary-search DP
solutions.strategy: Sort by end time and binary-search the latest compatible end before taking each job.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting and one binary search per job dominate.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The sorted jobs, end-time array, and DP table are stored.
